purpose: Objective -> candidate banking mechanisms. Consumed by J5; the single source of truth for the mechanism table.

travel.label: travel
travel.why: A dated, sized goal is funded by a dedicated savings pot, not by borrowing.

asset.label: asset
asset.why: A vehicle or property purchase legitimately admits both a cash and a financed construct.

protection.label: protection
protection.why: Acute risk needs cover first; a reserve supplements it and can never replace it.

liquidity.label: liquidity
liquidity.why: A cash buffer needs liquidity, not a long-dated contract.

wealth.label: wealth
wealth.why: Wealth creation is an allocation problem.

debt.label: debt
debt.why: Paying down expensive debt dominates comparable risk-adjusted returns.
